fact: Law No. 24.001, in force from promulgation, bars transfer of personal data to a foreign State unless it offers similar protection (art. 21), requires prior notice to the agency for transfers outside CEMAC/CEEAC (art. 25), and lets the agency authorise transfers on contractual guarantees (art. 27).
title: Loi n°24.001 portant protection des données à caractère personnel
publisher: Ministère de l'Economie Numérique, des Postes et Télécommunications (République centrafricaine)
